title: Editor Ecosystem Fearless Refactor v1
problem: Keep Fret's editor-facing ecosystem coherent while it scales: reusable editor widgets stay in fret-ui-editor, authoring syntax stays thin in fret-imui, shell chrome stays in fret-workspace, dock-aware policy stays in fret-docking, viewport tooling converges through fret-viewport-tooling and fret-gizmo, and app-local inspector/project protocols stay app-owned until a second consumer justifies extraction.

repro.summary: Use the promoted editor proof demo and focused ui-editor/imui diag scripts as the first runnable surface before moving boundaries or growing component APIs.
commands: cargo run -p fretboard -- dev native --package fret-demo --bin imui_editor_proof_demo

cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag run tools/diag-scripts/ui-editor/imui/imui-editor-proof-editor-components-screenshots-default.json --session-auto --pack --ai-packet --include-screenshots --launch -- cargo run -p fret-demo --bin imui_editor_proof_demo

cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag run tools/diag-scripts/ui-editor/imui/imui-editor-proof-name-assist-popup-screenshots.json --session-auto --pack --ai-packet --include-screenshots --launch -- cargo run -p fret-demo --bin imui_editor_proof_demo

gates.name: editor-shell-boundary-tests
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-workspace -p fret-docking -p fret-viewport-tooling -p fret-gizmo

continue_policy.notes: Continue this lane for boundary, token, component-system, and proof-surface orchestration. Implementation-heavy work should split into narrower follow-ons unless it is a direct update to the listed docs. Do not move apps/fret-editor protocols directly into fret-ui-editor; property/inspector extraction needs a second consumer or a deliberately scoped protocol crate. Keep EER-THEME-122, EER-CLEANUP-135, EER-Q-141, and EER-Q-142 explicit until they are resolved or split.
